title.value: Biomedical image analysis competitions: The state of current participation practice
title.justification: The title of the paper clearly identifies the paper as a discussion on the current practices surrounding biomedical image analysis competitions.
title.quote: Biomedical image analysis competitions: The state of current participation practice

extractions.description: This paper evaluates the participation practices in biomedical image analysis competitions, specifically IEEE ISBI 2021 and MICCAI 2021. It involves an international survey targeted at participants to uncover common practices and challenges they face such as method development time constraints, infrastructure bottlenecks, and the prevalence of standard architectures in algorithm development.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on biomedical image analysis competitions rather than ecological or climate-related themes.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: To shed light on the status quo of algorithm development in the specific field of biomedical imaging analysis, we designed an international survey...
